meta.name: Basic katana + saya (the user's own design)
meta.units: millimetres (Blender builds in metres: divide by 1000; Unreal cm: divide by 10)
meta.authority: This file + KATANA_DESIGN_SHEET.png are the reference. The builds read numbers from here.
meta.ip: Generic historical form (shinogi-zukuri uchigatana in plain koshirae). No named blade, smith, school, brand, film or game design is copied. Menuki form is an abstract lozenge of our own.

frame_sword.origin: Grip socket: primary (right) hand centre on the tsuka axis, 37 mm below the fuchi's lower edge
frame_sword.+Z: along the tsuka toward the blade (the blade curves away from +Z toward +X)
frame_sword.+X: mune (spine) side; the tip sweeps toward +X; the cutting edge faces -X
frame_sword.-Y: omote (the side seen with the handle left and the edge up); omote menuki, kurikata side of the saya
frame_sword.tsuka_axis: the Z axis is the tsuka's long axis and the blade's tangent at the machi

blade.type: shinogi-zukuri, iori-mune, chu-kissaki, torii-zori (centred curve), no hi (no groove)
blade.sori_shape: the mune is a CIRCULAR ARC tangent to the tsuka axis at the mune-machi; the draw from the saya is a rotation about its centre
blade.width_rule: linear in mune arc length from the machi (31.0) to the yokote (22.0); measured along the section normal (radial from the arc centre)
blade.thickness_rule: linear in arc length machi -> yokote; inside the kissaki linear to tip_thickness

edge_thickness.note: game minimum; reads as sharp at any distance

blade.shinogi_ji_note: the shinogi ridge sits 0.27 x local width from the mune peak: 8.37 mm at the machi, 5.94 mm at the yokote

hira_niku.peak_at: half way from the shinogi to the edge (niku * 4f(1-f))
hira_niku.note: convex bulge of each hira-ji face above the straight shinogi-to-edge line

kissaki.yokote: straight crisp crease across the blade, perpendicular to the mune at the yokote station
kissaki.fukura: fukura-tsuku (moderately full): width w(q) = 22.0 x (1 - q^1.8)^0.7, q = arc fraction yokote -> tip
kissaki.ko_shinogi: continues the shinogi line from the mitsukado to the tip at 0.27 x local width from the mune, crisp
kissaki.point: the tip lies on the mune arc

blade.machi_nakago: ha-machi and mune-machi notches and the nakago are inside the habaki / tsuka and are NOT modelled; the blade mesh starts at the machi plane (z 58) under the habaki
blade.section_points: per station, in (u = distance from the mune PEAK (the arc) toward the edge along the radial normal, y = thickness): mune peak (0, 0); mune shoulders (roof, +-0.37k); shinogi (0.27w, +-k/2); hira-ji f = 0.25/0.5/0.75 from shinogi to edge: (lerp(0.27w, w, f), +-(lerp(k/2, e/2, f) + niku*4f(1-f))); edge (w, +-e/2). Width w is measured from the mune peak.

hamon.style: ko-notare (gentle low wave) with a soft nioi line; ko-maru boshi; plain, nothing dramatic

distance_from_edge.rule: linear in arc length, measured across the hira-ji from the edge

undulation.note: sum of these half-cosine waves laid end to end from the machi; deterministic; the ura uses the same curve shifted 15 mm toward the tip

hamon.starts: at the machi (hidden under the habaki); visible from the habaki top
hamon.look: hardened zone (edge -> hamon) frosted pale grey-white, higher roughness; ji polished dark blue-grey; boundary soft over the nioi band

habaki.shape: single-piece plain habaki: rounded-rectangle section (superellipse n 4), straight taper, flat top face perpendicular to the blade, crisp 0.4 mm bevels, no file marks or crest

tsuba.form: maru-gata (round), plain plate, no openings (no hitsu-ana), no relief
tsuba.seppa_dai: plain, flush with the plate, not outlined
tsuba.finish: blackened iron, satin; faint hand-forged surface in the normal map only (<= 0.05 mm), no pattern

fuchi.edges: top edge bevel 0.5, lower (ito) edge rounded 0.6
fuchi.finish: blackened iron, plain, matches the tsuba

tsuka.shape: haichi: the mune side straight, the ha side tapering slightly toward the kashira; oval section (superellipse n 2.8); the tsuka axis is straight
tsuka.core: ho wood under one full white same panel wrapping all round (not visible except through the diamonds)

same.nodules: dense rounded nodules 0.6 - 1.2 mm, in the normal map + subtle AO; no large 'emperor' nodule

ito.style: hineri-maki (twisted at every crossing), top cord alternating at successive crossings
ito.width_rule: width = lerp(8.0, 16.0, |l|^1.5), l = lateral position across the face (0 at the crossing, 1 at the edge): the flat ito spreads as it folds over the hishigami and closes the diamond's side points
ito.path_model: two opposite wraps. Helix angle phi = -90deg +- 360deg * (z_fuchi_bot - 0.25 pitch - z) / pitch (from +X toward +Y; -90deg = omote centre, 0 = mune edge). The lateral position across the face l = 1 - |wrap(phi)| / 90deg is a triangle wave of z, so in the side view each cord runs in a STRAIGHT diagonal from a crossing to the edge; the face (omote/ura) is sign(sin phi). The cords cross only at the face centres; omote and ura crossings are offset by half a pitch; each edge (ha, mune) is crossed by one cord every half pitch
ito.crossing: the upper cord twists (hineri) at each face crossing: it is turned over on itself so it stands up as a sharp fold ridge ~1.0 mm above the lower cord along the crossing's long axis; the over/under alternates at successive crossings of a face
ito.edges: over the ha and mune edges each cord is lifted ~0.8 mm by its hishigami and spread to 16 mm, so the edge silhouette is scalloped (one bump per half pitch, >= 1 mm) and no same shows on the edges
ito.hishigami: folded paper triangles under the cord at every edge pass: base 14 mm along the edge, 9.5 mm into the face, lifting the cord 0.8 mm; they close the diamonds' side corners to points
ito.fuchi_end: cords start under the fuchi's lower edge, no knot
ito.kashira_end: the two cords pass through the kashira's eyelets and over the end as one flat double band (2 x 8 mm) from omote to ura; ends hidden under the last crossings; NOTHING hangs
ito.diamond_opening: 17.8 mm along the axis x 31.9 mm across (measured on the sheet model, omote face, the 4th diamond)

menuki.form: our own plain form: a domed lozenge with a low lengthwise centre ridge, rounded ends

omote.where: third full diamond from the fuchi

ura.where: third full diamond from the kashira

menuki.seating: on the same, under the ito; the cords pass over both ends and rise over them

mekugi.visible: omote: centred in the first full diamond; ura: under the first ura crossing
mekugi.head: slightly domed, 0.3 above the same

kashira.profile: straight sides for 7 mm, then a low dome closing over the last 4 mm (end crown nearly flat, 3.5 mm rise)

saya.construction: ho wood, black roiro (gloss) lacquer, buffalo-horn koiguchi, kurikata and kojiri; no kaeshizuno; no sageo
saya.frame: pivot = BeltMount, on the mouth's tangent axis at the kurikata station; axes = the seated sword's axes; saya frame = sword frame - (0, 0, 138.3)
saya.curve: concentric with the blade's mune arc (same centre); every station is given as a mune-arc length s from the machi of the seated sword
saya.mune_outer_rule: mune clearance 0.5 + mune wall 4.0 -> the saya's mune line sits 4.5 mm outside the blade's mune
saya.section: superellipse n 2.4 in the (radial, Y) plane, centred radially at mune_outer + depth/2

koiguchi.mouth_face: flat, perpendicular to the arc, 0.4 mm round on the outer edge

kurikata.profile: rounded 'chestnut' knob: semicircular ends seen face-on, domed top

hole.axis: radial (X): through the knob, parallel to the face

shitodome.faces: both X faces of the knob

cavity.rule: the seated blade (all LODs) + clearance: edge side 1.0, sides 1.0, mune 0.5; ends at s 716.09 (10 mm past the tip)
cavity.habaki_pocket: the habaki + 0.1 all round, from the mouth to 0.5 below the habaki top, swept along the draw arc

saya.sageo: OMITTED: no cord on the mesh (a static cord freezes in one pose). The kurikata and its open shitodome stay, so a cord can be added later as a separate rigged or simulated piece

sheathed.seat: the blade-side seppa face sits 0.3 mm from the koiguchi face; the habaki is fully inside the koiguchi (0 mm visible); the whole blade is inside; the tip stops 10 mm short of the cavity end
sheathed.draw: rotation in the X-Z plane about the arc centre (saya frame x 3678.60, z -80.30), the blade leaving toward -Z; the arc swept to the tip is 11.04 deg
gates: 0 intersecting triangles, every sword LOD x saya LOD pair
seat gap seppa -> koiguchi 0.3 +- 0.2 mm; 0 mm of habaki visible
every blade vertex enclosed by the cavity; blade clearance >= 0.4 mm
clean draw along the arc in <= 0.25 deg steps, 0 intersections at every step
wall >= 3.0 mm everywhere (>= 2.3 at the koiguchi around the habaki pocket: the design minimum there is 2.35 at the pocket corners)

katana_mm_extra.note: BladeMid = blade centre line at half the mune arc; TrailEnd = centre line 15 mm (arc) short of the tip; CenterOfMass is computed by the builder from part volumes

saya_mm_extra.note: the arc centre in the saya frame; a clean draw rotates the katana about this point (about Y) by up to 12.04 deg

sockets.rotations: zero, except BladeTip: pitch = the blade tangent at the tip, 11.044 deg from +Z toward +X. The Holster takes the sword's Grip with zero relative rotation
sockets.precedence: positions here follow this design; KATANA_BUILD_PLAN.md section 6 lists the same sockets with nominal numbers that these replace

materials.note: sRGB hex for base colour; roughness / metallic as authored. Metals 1.0, everything else 0.0 (house rule: no partial metallic)

slots_and_pack.precedence: ADVISORY. KATANA_BUILD_PLAN.md (the game/tech plan) governs slots, texture sizes, budgets, LOD screen sizes and collision where it differs; this spec governs every dimension, form, pattern and colour
SM_Katana: M_Katana_Fittings (habaki, seppa, tsuba, fuchi, kashira, menuki, eyelets)
SM_Katana_Saya: M_Katana_Saya_Horn (koiguchi, kurikata, kojiri; shitodome brass via ORM metallic)
slots_and_pack.pack_masters: Blade + Fittings -> M_Steel_Master; Grip -> M_Fabric_Master (ito colour); Lacquer -> M_Fabric_Master; Horn -> M_Fabric_Master with Metal From ORM (as the Snow Flower sheath). Finaliser decides.
slots_and_pack.textures: 2048 per atlas (small held item rule); BC sRGB, ORM linear, N DirectX; full mips
slots_and_pack.texel_targets: blade >= 20 px/cm, grip >= 40 px/cm, saya >= 20 px/cm

budgets.lod_rule: authored LODs; LOD1 keeps the ito as real geometry (fewer segments); LOD2 may bake the ito to a normal map on the core

collision.SM_Katana: 5 hulls UCX_SM_Katana_LOD0_00..04: blade base / mid / kissaki third (along the arc), tsuba, tsuka (fuchi..kashira)
collision.SM_Katana_Saya: 3 hulls UCX_SM_Katana_Saya_LOD0_00..02 along the arc (top one includes the kurikata), the top hull cut at the mouth plane

judging: blind test against KATANA_DESIGN_SHEET.png views: a judge must not pick the build on design
key dimensions within +-0.5 mm (nagasa, sori, motohaba, sakihaba, kasane, kissaki, habaki, tsuba, tsuka, saya depth/width) on the exported bytes
ito is real geometry: 9 crossings per face, 8 full diamonds, omote/ura offset half a pitch, hineri twist with alternating over/under, menuki at the specified diamonds
hamon is plain ko-notare with a ko-maru boshi; nothing the spec does not call for

design_sheet_measured.note: side-view projection of the cords on the omote face; the across value reaches the silhouette where the opening touches the face edges
